      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "The One Percent Solution",
      "goal": "Introduce the protagonist to the System and reveal the broken 'Crit' multiplier during a fatal tutorial encounter.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From certain death as a mundane human to survival as a glitched outlier with a lethal damage ceiling.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Protagonist dies in the real world and awakens in the tutorial zone.",
        "to_next": "Armed with a broken mechanic, the protagonist seeks to maximize tutorial rewards before the zone closes."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 3,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 8
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Fatal Error",
          "intent": "Establish the protagonist's mundane death and the jarring transition into the System tutorial.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist awakens in the white-room tutorial space and receives the first System prompt.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie dies in a hospital bed and experiences a surreal transition into a digital void.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Artie is transported to the tutorial zone.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Earth Hospital Room",
              "location_start": "A sterile, dimly lit hospital room on Earth.",
              "location_end_label": "White Void Entrance",
              "location_end": "The threshold of the infinite white tutorial space.",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie’s consciousness slips away as the hospital room monitor emits a long, flat tone.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["flatline tone", "antiseptic scent", "dimming hospital lights"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie’s eyes snap open to find himself standing in a featureless white expanse.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blinding white floor", "infinite horizon", "digital hum"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie explores the white void and interacts with the first System prompt.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie accepts the tutorial and gains his first status window.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "location_start_label": "White Void Entrance",
              "location_start": "The threshold of the infinite white tutorial space.",
              "location_end_label": "White Void Center",
              "location_end": "The heart of the tutorial white-room.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The humming of the white expanse intensifies as a blue window flickers into existence.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blue system window", "glowing text", "digital chime"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist awakens in the white-room tutorial space and receives the first System prompt.",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie reaches out to touch the floating prompt, and the world shifts around him.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["shimmering pixels", "tactile interface", "warping space"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Identifying the Glitch",
          "intent": "Introduce the combat mechanics and the first realization that the Crit multiplier is behaving abnormally.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist successfully triggers a 100x crit on a training dummy, causing a physics error.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie approaches a training dummy and attempts basic combat maneuvers.",
              "type": "trial",
              "outcome": "Artie learns the basics of the combat system.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "location_start_label": "White Void Center",
              "location_start": "The heart of the tutorial white-room.",
              "location_end_label": "Training Arena",
              "location_end": "A designated combat zone within the white void.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The white void resolves into a structured training arena containing a single straw dummy.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["straw training dummy", "combat circle", "wooden sword"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie grips the wooden sword, feeling the strange weight of a digital weapon.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["rough wood grain", "digital weight", "practice stance"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie strikes the dummy multiple times, noticing a strange variance in damage numbers.",
              "type": "investigation",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies a pattern in his critical hits.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_GLITCH"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "location_start_label": "Training Arena",
              "location_start": "A designated combat zone within the white void.",
              "location_end_label": "Training Arena",
              "location_end": "A designated combat zone within the white void.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The first strike lands with a dull thud, but the damage readout flickers erratically.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["floating damage numbers", "dull thud", "flickering text"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie narrows his eyes as a '1.5x' multiplier suddenly jumps to '10x' for no reason.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["golden multiplier text", "sparking impact", "surprised expression"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie focuses on the timing of his strikes and triggers a massive physics-breaking crit.",
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "The training dummy is destroyed by a 100x crit.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_GLITCH"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "location_start_label": "Training Arena",
              "location_start": "A designated combat zone within the white zone.",
              "location_end_label": "Training Arena",
              "location_end": "A designated combat zone within the white zone.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie swings with everything he has, aiming for the exact moment the multiplier glitches.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rhythmic swing", "glowing blade edge", "intense focus"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist successfully triggers a 100x crit on a training dummy, causing a physics error.",
              "transition_out_text": "The dummy vanishes in a spray of corrupted pixels as the System struggles to calculate the damage.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["corrupted pixels", "shattered straw", "error message"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The First Payday",
          "intent": "Show the protagonist intentionally using the glitch to secure high-value loot from the first tutorial mob.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist loots a 'Legendary' starter dagger from a common tutorial rat due to overkill bonuses.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie enters the first live-combat zone and encounters a tutorial rat.",
              "type": "trial",
              "outcome": "Artie prepares to test the glitch on a live enemy.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "location_start_label": "Training Arena",
              "location_start": "A designated combat zone within the white void.",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Dungeon Entrance",
              "location_end": "A stone-walled corridor at the edge of the void.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A stone corridor manifests around Artie, smelling of damp earth and digital decay.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["stone walls", "damp earth scent", "iron sconce"],
              "transition_out_text": "A pair of red eyes glows in the darkness of the corridor ahead.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["glowing red eyes", "chattering sound", "shadowy movement"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie engages the tutorial rat, carefully managing his strikes to build the multiplier.",
              "type": "trial",
              "outcome": "Artie successfully stacks the glitch against the rat.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_GLITCH"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Dungeon Entrance",
              "location_start": "A stone-walled corridor at the edge of the void.",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Dungeon Entrance",
              "location_end": "A stone-walled corridor at the edge of the void.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The tutorial rat lunges, but Artie sidesteps, waiting for the multiplier to pulse.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rat claws", "sidestep maneuver", "pulsing UI"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie brings the wooden sword down in a perfect arc as the multiplier hits its peak.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["perfect arc", "peak multiplier", "descending strike"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "The rat is obliterated by an overkill strike, and Artie loots a legendary item.",
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie acquires the 'Legendary' starter dagger.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_GLITCH"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Dungeon Entrance",
              "location_start": "A stone-walled corridor at the edge of the void.",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Dungeon Entrance",
              "location_end": "A stone-walled corridor at the edge of the void.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The rat explodes with the force of a small bomb, leaving behind a shimmering golden chest.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["golden chest", "shimmering loot", "smoke tendrils"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist loots a 'Legendary' starter dagger from a common tutorial rat due to overkill bonuses."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "Looting the Logic Gates",
      "goal": "Systematically dismantle tutorial challenges to acquire high-tier 'Starter' gear through overkill bonuses.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "From a lucky survivor to a heavily geared exploiter who is now ahead of the intended power curve.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "The protagonist realizes the System rewards 'overkill' damage with better loot drops.",
        "to_next": "The protagonist enters the first major hub city and attracts unwanted attention from the local guard."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Overkill Protocol",
          "intent": "The protagonist tests the limits of the 'Crit' multiplier to maximize loot drops across multiple encounters.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist confirms that damage exceeding 1000% of enemy HP guarantees a rarity tier jump.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie tests the Legendary Dagger on a group of tutorial slimes.",
              "type": "trial",
              "outcome": "Artie confirms the dagger synergizes with the glitch.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Field",
              "location_start": "An open grassy area within the tutorial zone.",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Field",
              "location_end": "An open grassy area within the tutorial zone.",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie steps into the Tutorial Field, testing the weight of his new Legendary Dagger.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["Legendary Dagger", "pixelated grass", "tutorial sun"],
              "transition_out_text": "A cluster of blue slimes wobbles toward him, perfect for another round of testing.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blue slime", "wobbling movement", "ready stance"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie performs precise overkill strikes on the slimes, recording the loot results.",
              "type": "investigation",
              "outcome": "Artie notices a correlation between overkill percentage and loot quality.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_GLITCH"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Field",
              "location_start": "An open grassy area within the tutorial zone.",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Field",
              "location_end": "An open grassy area within the tutorial zone.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The first slime pops like a water balloon under the dagger's glitched edge.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["slime residue", "dagger edge", "loot window"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie opens his log, comparing the damage numbers to the items dropped.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["system log", "item list", "calculating gaze"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie pushes the multiplier to 1000% on the final slime of the pack.",
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie confirms the 1000% overkill threshold for rarity jumps.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_GLITCH"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Field",
              "location_start": "An open grassy area within the tutorial zone.",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Field",
              "location_end": "An open grassy area within the tutorial zone.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The last slime expands as Artie charges his strike, the multiplier climbing toward four digits.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["expanding slime", "charged strike", "four-digit multiplier"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist confirms that damage exceeding 1000% of enemy HP guarantees a rarity tier jump.",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie pockets the Rare Slime Core and looks toward the looming Boss Room.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["Rare Slime Core", "Boss Room door", "determined walk"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Boss Room Bypass",
          "intent": "A high-intensity fight where the protagonist uses the glitch to one-shot the Tutorial Boss.",
          "end_condition": "The Tutorial Boss is vaporized by a single strike, dropping a unique 'Glitched' item.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie approaches the Boss Room and prepares his buffs.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie is ready for the final tutorial challenge.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Room Entrance",
              "location_start": "A massive iron-bound door at the end of the tutorial dungeon.",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Room Entrance",
              "location_end": "A massive iron-bound door at the end of the tutorial dungeon.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The air grows heavy with the scent of ozone as Artie stands before the Boss Room door.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["iron-bound door", "heavy air", "ozone scent"],
              "transition_out_text": "He consumes a temporary strength potion, his muscles tightening for the coming blow.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["potion bottle", "glowing veins", "tightened grip"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie enters the Boss Room and faces the Tutorial Guardian.",
              "type": "trial",
              "outcome": "The fight begins, and Artie dodges the Guardian's initial attacks.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Room",

              "location_end_label": "Boss Room",
              "location_end": "A circular stone chamber with a vaulted ceiling.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The doors slam shut behind Artie as the Tutorial Guardian rises from its throne.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["Tutorial Guardian", "stone throne", "slamming doors"],
              "transition_out_text": "The Guardian swings a massive stone club, which Artie narrowly avoids.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["stone club", "shattering floor", "narrow dodge"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie waits for the perfect opening to trigger the glitch.",
              "type": "trial",
              "outcome": "Artie finds the 'logic gap' in the Guardian's defense.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_GLITCH"],

              "location_start_label": "Boss Room",
              "location_start": "A circular stone chamber with a vaulted ceiling.",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Room",
              "location_end": "A circular stone chamber with a vaulted ceiling.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie circles the Guardian, watching the way its digital frame stutters during a heavy swing.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["digital stutter", "heavy swing", "circling movement"],
              "transition_out_text": "He lunges forward, aiming for the glowing core exposed in the Guardian's chest.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["glowing core", "lunge maneuver", "exposed weakness"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie strikes the core with a massive glitched crit.",
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "The Boss is destroyed, and Artie gains a glitched item.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_GLITCH"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Room",
              "location_start": "A circular stone chamber with a vaulted ceiling.",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Room",
              "location_end": "A circular stone chamber with a vaulted ceiling.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The Legendary Dagger sinks into the core, and the damage numbers begin to spiral out of control.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["spiraling numbers", "impact spark", "shuddering boss"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The Tutorial Boss is vaporized by a single strike, dropping a unique 'Glitched' item.",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie picks up the pulsing 'Glitched Fragment' from the pile of boss loot.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["Glitched Fragment", "loot pile", "pulsing light"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Graduation Day",
          "intent": "The protagonist prepares to leave the tutorial zone with an inventory full of unintended gear.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist steps through the tutorial exit portal into the main game world.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie organizes his inventory and equips his new gear.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie is fully geared for the main game.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Room",
              "location_start": "A circular stone chamber with a vaulted ceiling.",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Room",
              "location_end": "A circular stone chamber with a vaulted ceiling.",
              "handoff_mode": "aftermath_relocation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The dust settles in the Boss Room as Artie begins sorting through his overflowing inventory.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["settling dust", "inventory screens", "shining gear"],
              "transition_out_text": "He equips the 'Glitched Plate' and 'Tutorial Master's Boots', feeling his stats skyrocket.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["Glitched Plate", "Master's Boots", "stat notification"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Artie approaches the exit portal, reflecting on his progress.",
              "type": "investigation",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes he has broken the tutorial's intended balance.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Room",
              "location_start": "A circular stone chamber with a vaulted ceiling.",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Exit Portal",
              "location_end": "A swirling blue vortex at the back of the chamber.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A swirling blue vortex opens at the back of the chamber, beckoning him toward the real world.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blue vortex", "swirling energy", "exit prompt"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie takes a final look at the tutorial zone, a smirk playing on his lips.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["final look", "smirk", "portal edge"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Artie steps into the portal and leaves the tutorial.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Artie arrives in the main game hub.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:9",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Exit Portal",
              "location_start": "A swirling blue vortex at the back of the chamber.",

              "location_end": "The bustling central plaza of the first city.",

              "transition_in_anchors": ["kaleidoscope of light", "rushing wind", "dissolving world"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist steps through the tutorial exit portal into the main game world."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
